inj.note: McMahon won't be eligible to play again until Week 16 against the Seahawks, but it wouldn't be surprising if the third-year center was sidelined beyond the minimum four games. With Coleman Shelton also expected to miss 4-to-6 weeks due to a hamstring injury, Beaux Limmer is the next man up at center for the Rams, who will return to action Nov. 25 versus the Packers following a Week 11 bye.
